slides.title: Kirish: suyak rezorbsiyasi nima?

bullets.text: Skelet tayanch vazifasini bajaradi, miya va yurak kabi a’zolarni himoya qiladi hamda kalsiy va boshqa elementlar zaxirasi bo‘lib xizmat qiladi.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

bullets.text: Rezorbsiya — osteoklastlarning suyak mineral va organik qismini yemirishi. Suyak massasi rezorbsiya va osteoblastlar hosil qilgan yangi suyak muvozanatiga bog‘liq.

source.author: Shunsuke Uehara va boshq.
source.title: Beyond resorption: targeting osteoclast fusion and polarization to restore balanced bone remodeling, Frontiers in Pharmacology

bullets.text: Muvozanat buzilsa, rezorbsiya umumiy suyak yo‘qolishiga (osteoporoz) yoki mahalliy, rentgenda litik o‘choqlarga olib keladi.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

bullets.text: Qo‘shma protezdan keyin ortiqcha rezorbsiya hosil bo‘lishdan oshib ketsa, periprostetik osteoliz (PPO) yuzaga keladi va implant bo‘shashadi.

source.author: Yin L va boshq.
source.title: Critical signaling pathways in osteoclast differentiation and bone resorption: mechanisms and therapeutic implications for periprosthetic osteolysis, Frontiers in Cell and Developmental Biology

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama savoli: 1) Nega suyak faqat tayanch emas, kalsiy zaxirasi hamdir? 2) Rezorbsiya har doim kasallikmi? Doskada chizish: ikki pallali tarozi (osteoklast va osteoblast). Shakllar tasnifi: fiziologik qayta qurilish, umumiy yo‘qolish (osteoporoz), mahalliy litik o‘choqlar, implant atrofidagi osteoliz. Tipik xato: rezorbsiyani doim patologiya deb tushunish — normal qayta qurilishning ajralmas bosqichi.

slides.title: Suyak qayta qurilishi sikli

bullets.text: Osteoklastlar mikroskopik eskirgan yoki shikastlangan suyakni yemiradi, osteoblastlar uning o‘rniga yangi suyak qo‘yadi.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

bullets.text: Osteoklast ~60 µm chuqur zovur — suyak qayta qurilish birligi (BRU) — hosil qiladi; zovur tubi qaytish chizig‘i bilan belgilanadi.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

bullets.text: Matriksdan va osteoklastdan ajralgan bog‘lovchi omillar osteoblast avlodlarini rezorbsiya joyiga chaqiradi.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 7 daq. Muhokama savoli: 1) Rezorbsiya joyiga osteoblastlarni nima chaqiradi? 2) Qaytish chizig‘i nimani ko‘rsatadi? Doskada chizish: trabekula yuzasida zovur va uning tubidagi qaytish chizig‘i. Tipik xato: osteoklast va osteoblast ishini bir vaqtda, bir joyda deb o‘ylash; avval rezorbsiya, keyin shakllanish. Diqqat: qaytish chizig‘i ≠ yangi suyak qatlami; u zovur tubining belgisi. Patologiyada chiziq tartibsiz bo‘ladi (mozaik ko‘rinish, Paget kasalligida).

slides.title: Osteoklast suyakni qanday yemiradi

bullets.text: Ruffled border — membrananing barmoqsimon burmalari; kislota va ferment ajratish yuzasini oshiradi.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

bullets.text: Sealing zone — suyakka zich yopishgan halqa; lakunani yopiq lizosomal bo‘shliqqa aylantiradi.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

bullets.text: Lakuna, ko‘rinishidan, yupqa kollagen qopqoq — kanopi — bilan yopiladi; u qo‘shni ilikni himoya qiladi.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 8 daq. Muhokama savoli: 1) Nega katepsin K faqat mineral erigandan keyin samarali ishlaydi? 2) Sealing zone buzilsa nima bo‘ladi? Doskada chizish: osteoklast kesimi — ruffled border, sealing zone, lakuna va kanopi. Qo‘shimcha: osteoklast avval xlorid kislota ajratib mineralni eritadi, keyin metalloproteazalar va katepsin K kollagen matriksni parchalaydi; parchalar hujayra orqali o‘tib sinusoidlar orqali qonga chiqariladi. Tipik xato: kislota kollagenni ham eritadi deb o‘ylash — kollagenni fermentlar parchalaydi.

slides.title: G‘ovak va kortikal suyakda rezorbsiya

bullets.text: Osteoklastlar g‘ovak suyak yuzasida transhey shaklidagi qayta qurish birligini (BRU) hosil qiladi.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

bullets.text: Transheya o‘rtacha ~60 μm chuqurlikkacha yemiriladi. Uning tubi qaytish chizig‘i bilan belgilanadi.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

bullets.text: Zich kortikal suyakda osteoklastlar dumaloq tunnel ochadi. Tunnel yangi suyak bilan to‘lib, osteonga aylanadi.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

diagram.caption: Ikki suyak turida rezorbsiya
rows: Zich qatlam, g‘ovak suyakni o‘rab turadi
Yangi suyak bilan to‘lib, osteon bo‘ladi

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega transheya silliq tubli bo‘ladi? 2) Osteon ichida qanday tomirlar bor? Doskada: g‘ovak suyakdagi transheya va kortikal suyakdagi tunnelning kesimini yonma-yon chizing, qaytish chizig‘ini belgilang. Tipik xato: BRU ni faqat kortikal suyakka xos deb o‘ylash, yoki osteonni rezorbsiya o‘chog‘ining o‘zi deb hisoblash.

slides.title: Fiziologik va patologik rezorbsiya

bullets.text: Me‘yorda osteoklastlar silliq tubli transheya hosil qiladi, keyin osteoblastlar yangi suyak qo‘yadi.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

bullets.text: Infeksiya, yallig‘lanish, endokrin buzilish va metastazda BRU soni oshadi, suyak hosil bo‘lishi esa susayadi.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

bullets.text: Natija umumiy suyak yo‘qolishi (osteoporoz) yoki rentgenda ko‘rinadigan mahalliy litik o‘choq bo‘ladi.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) Qaysi kasalliklarda BRU soni ortadi? 2) Umumiy suyak yo‘qolishi bilan mahalliy litik o‘choq qanday farq qiladi? Doskada: ikki ustunli jadvalni talabalar bilan birga to‘ldiring. Tipik xato: osteoporozni faqat mahalliy jarayon deb hisoblash. Aslida u umumiy suyak yo‘qolishi.

slides.title: Voqea tahlili: mozaik tasvirli suyak

bullets.text: Vaziyat: gistologik kesmada (H&E bo‘yash) qaytish chiziqlari notekis, suyak mozaika ko‘rinishida.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

bullets.text: Rezorbsiya tezligi oshganda osteoklastlar tartibsiz ishlaydi. Klassik misol — Paget kasalligi.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

bullets.text: Savol: bu qanday rezorbsiya shakli va chiziqlar nima uchun tartibsiz?

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

bullets.text: Diqqat: silliq tubli transheya me‘yorni, notekis chiziq kuchaygan (patologik) rezorbsiyani bildiradi.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daq. Javob: bu patologik, kuchaygan rezorbsiya; tezlik oshgani uchun osteoklastlar tartibsiz ishlaydi va chiziqlar notekis bo‘ladi. Muhokama: 1) Mozaika ko‘rinishi nimani bildiradi? 2) Normal qaytish chizig‘i qanday ko‘rinadi? Doskada: silliq va notekis qaytish chizig‘ini ikki xil chizib solishtiring. Tipik xato: qaytish chizig‘ini o‘zi patologiya belgisi deb o‘ylash. Aslida normada ham bor, patologiyada uning tartibsizligi muhim.

slides.title: Tezkor savol: rezorbsiya asoslari

bullets.text: Savol 1: osteoklast suyak mineralini nima bilan eritadi? Javob: kislota. Proton nasoslari H+ ionlarini, xlor kanallari Cl− ionlarini ajratadi.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

bullets.text: Savol 2: mineral erigach, kollagenli matriksni nima parchalaydi? Javob: metalloproteazalar; asosiy proteolitik ferment — katepsin K.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

bullets.text: Savol 3: katepsin K qaysi pH da eng samarali, sealing zone nima qiladi? Javob: pH ~5,5; sealing zone yopiq lizosomal bo‘shliq hosil qilib, hujayralarni kislotadan himoya qiladi.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

bullets.text: Diqqat: xato qilish xavfi — demineralizatsiya (kislota bilan mineralning erishi) ≠ matriks parchalanishi (ferment); ular ketma-ket bosqichlar.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daqiqa. Muhokama: 1) Nima uchun mineral avval erishi kerak? 2) Sealing zone bo‘lmasa nima o‘zgaradi? Doskada chizish: osteoklast osti — ruffled border, sealing zone va lakunani sxematik chizing, H+ va katepsin K ni belgilang. Tipik xato: talabalar kislota kollagenni ham eritadi deb o‘ylaydi; aslida kollagenni ferment parchalaydi.

slides.title: Osteoklastning kelib chiqishi

bullets.text: Osteoklastlar suyak ko‘migidagi gemopoetik miyeloid prekursorlarning qo‘shilishidan hosil bo‘lgan ko‘p yadroli hujayralardir.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

bullets.text: M-CSF prekursorlarda RANK ifodasini oshiradi; RANKL ta’sirida ular differensiallanib, bir-biri bilan qo‘shiladi.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

bullets.text: RANKL va M-CSF osteoklastni lakunada saqlaydi; o‘rtacha umri taxminan 30 kun.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daqiqa. Muhokama: 1) Nima uchun ikkala sitokin (M-CSF va RANKL) ham kerak? 2) Qo‘shilish rezorbtiv faollikka qanday ta’sir qiladi? Doskada chizish: besh tugunli zanjirni strelkalar bilan chizing va har bosqichga sitokin nomini yozing. Tipik xato: osteoklastni osteoblast yoki mezenximal hujayradan kelib chiqadi deb adashtirish; u miyeloid (gemopoetik) qatordan.

slides.title: RANKL/RANK/OPG tizimi

bullets.text: RANKL osteoblast, osteotsit va immun hujayralarda ifodalanadi; RANK esa osteoklast prekursorlarida joylashgan.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

bullets.text: Eslab qoling: OPG – tabiiy tormoz; RANKL ni RANK dan kuchliroq bog‘lab, osteoklastni cheklaydi.

source.author: Yin L va boshq.
source.title: Critical signaling pathways in osteoclast differentiation and bone resorption: mechanisms and therapeutic implications for periprosthetic osteolysis, Frontiers in Cell and Developmental Biology

bullets.text: RANKL/OPG nisbati normal va kasal holatda suyak rezorbsiyasi darajasini belgilaydi.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

diagram.caption: Tizim ishtirokchilari
rows: RANKL ni bog‘laydi, TRAF6 ni chaqiradi
RANKL ni bog‘lab, RANK dan ushlab qoladi

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 7 daqiqa. Muhokama: 1) RANKL ko‘payib, OPG kamaysa suyakda nima bo‘ladi? 2) Nima uchun OPG ‘yolg‘on retseptor’ deyiladi? Doskada chizish: RANKL, RANK va OPG ni uch shakl sifatida chizib, OPG RANKL ni ushlab qolishini ko‘rsating. Tipik xato: OPG ni RANK bilan almashtirish; RANK membrana retseptori, OPG esa eruvchan yolg‘on retseptor.

slides.title: RANKL manbalari va aksessuar hujayralar

bullets.text: RANKL (NF-κB retseptori faollashtiruvchisi ligandi)ni osteoblast va stromal hujayralar, B va T limfositlar ifodalaydi. Ular aksessuar hujayralar deyiladi.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

bullets.text: Osteositlar suyakdagi eng ko‘p hujayralar bo‘lib, membranali va ajraluvchi RANKL chiqaradi. Embrionda bu RANKL shart emas, o‘smir va kattalarda remodellash uchun zarur.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

bullets.text: Revmatoid artritda yallig‘langan bo‘g‘imda sinovitsitlar RANKLning asosiy manbai. O‘sma nekrozi omili (TNF) aksessuar hujayralarda RANKLni oshiradi.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

bullets.text: Yallig‘langan suyak muhitida qon tomir endotelial hujayralari ham RANKL ajratib, osteoklast hosil bo‘lishiga hissa qo‘shadi.

source.author: Yin L va boshq.
source.title: Critical signaling pathways in osteoclast differentiation and bone resorption: mechanisms and therapeutic implications for periprosthetic osteolysis, Frontiers in Cell and Developmental Biology

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6-7 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega osteosit RANKLi embrionda kerak emas, kattalarda esa zarur? 2) Yallig‘lanishda qaysi hujayralar RANKL manbaiga qo‘shiladi? Doskada chizing: markazda osteoklast prekursori, atrofida 5 ta RANKL manbai (osteoblast, osteosit, T/B limfosit, sinovitsit, endotelial hujayra) strelkalar bilan. Tipik xato: faqat osteoblastni RANKL manbai deb o‘ylash.

slides.title: RANKL/OPG nisbati buzilishi

bullets.text: RANKL osteoklast hosil bo‘lishi uchun asosiy omil. OPG esa RANKLni tutib, rezorbsiyani cheklaydi.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

bullets.text: RANKL va OPG nisbati norma va kasallikda rezorbsiya darajasini belgilovchi asosiy omil.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

bullets.text: Diqqat: zich suyak ≠ mustahkam suyak. Osteopetrozda suyak to‘qilgan (woven) turda va mo‘rt.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 7 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega osteopetroz suyagi rentgenda zich, lekin sinuvchan? 2) RANKL/OPG nisbati periprotez osteolizida qanday o‘zgaradi? Doskada chizing: tarozi, bir pallada RANKL, ikkinchisida OPG, ikki xil og‘ish. Tipik xato: osteopetrozni osteoporoz bilan aralashtirish yoki zich suyakni mustahkam deb hisoblash. Jadvaldagi OPG qatori ma’lumotlari Yin va boshq. (PMID 40932933) dan: OPG-nokaut sichqonlarda erta osteoporoz va sinuvchanlik.

slides.title: Wnt signali va LGR4 ning roli

bullets.text: Wnt/β-katenin signali mezenximal ildiz hujayralaridan osteoblast hosil bo‘lishini boshqaradi. Kanonik yo‘l osteoblastlarda OPG ifodasini ham oshiradi.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

bullets.text: Wnt3a va Wnt16 RANKL keltirib chiqargan NF-κB–NFATc1 (T-hujayralar yadro omili) ifodasini to‘sib, rezorbsiyani cheklaydi. Wnt4a ham osteoklast hosil bo‘lishini to‘sadi.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

bullets.text: Wnt5a osteoklast prekursorlarida RANK ifodasini oshiradi. β-katenin erta prekursorlarda differensiatsiyani kuchaytiradi, yetilganlarda to‘sadi.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

bullets.text: LGR4 (leysinga boy takrorli G-oqsil bilan bog‘liq retseptor 4) RANKL uchun qo‘shimcha retseptor; RANK bilan raqobatlashib, Gαq va GSK3-β orqali NFATc1 ni bostiradi.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6-7 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega Wnt signalini osteoklastogenezda ikki yoqlama deyish mumkin? 2) LGR4 RANK bilan qanday raqobatlashadi va natija nima? Doskada chizing: RANKL ikki retseptor (RANK va LGR4) o‘rtasida, RANK tomoni NFATc1 ni oshiradi, LGR4 tomoni bostiradi. Tipik xato: barcha Wnt oqsillarini bir xil ta’sir qiladi deb o‘ylash (Wnt5a RANKni oshiradi, Wnt3a/16/4a cheklaydi).

slides.title: Voqea tahlili: RANKL‘siz sichqonlar

bullets.text: Vaziyat: RANKL yoki RANK geni o‘chirilgan sichqonlarda osteoklast va TRAP (tartratga chidamli kislotali fosfataza) bo‘yalishi yo‘q; iligi bo‘shlig‘ini zich suyak to‘ldiradi.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

bullets.text: Savolga javob: osteoklast bo‘lmasa, mineralli suyak matritsasi uzun suyaklar va umurtqalar iligi bo‘shlig‘idan olib tashlanmaydi. Bu holat osteopetroz deyiladi.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

bullets.text: Osteopetrotik suyak rentgenda nur o‘tkazmaydi, uchlari kolbasimon. Zich ko‘rinsa ham, to‘qilgan (woven) suyakdan iborat bo‘lgani uchun normal suyakdan zaif.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

bullets.text: Diqqat: zich suyak ≠ mustahkam suyak. Osteoklast yo‘qligi suyakni kuchli emas, aksincha mo‘rt qiladi.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) Osteoklast yo‘q bo‘lsa remodeling nima uchun to‘xtaydi? 2) Nima uchun rentgenda suyak oq, lekin sinishga moyil? Doskada: normal va RANK−/− sichqon boldir suyagining o‘q kesimini chizing (o‘sish plastinkasi, iligi bo‘shlig‘i, zich suyak). Tipik xato: talabalar zich suyakni kuchli suyak deb o‘ylaydi.

slides.title: NF-κB signal yo‘li: ikki tarmoq

bullets.text: Kanonik yo‘lda IκB kinaza (IKK) kompleksi IKKβ orqali IκBα ni fosforlaydi, RelA/p50 yadroga o‘tadi.

source.author: Yin L va boshq.
source.title: Critical signaling pathways in osteoclast differentiation and bone resorption: mechanisms and therapeutic implications for periprosthetic osteolysis, Frontiers in Cell and Developmental Biology

bullets.text: Noan‘anaviy yo‘lda NIK (NF-κB induksiyalovchi kinaza) IKKα ni faollaydi, p100 esa p52 ga ishlanadi.

source.author: Yin L va boshq.
source.title: Critical signaling pathways in osteoclast differentiation and bone resorption: mechanisms and therapeutic implications for periprosthetic osteolysis, Frontiers in Cell and Developmental Biology

bullets.text: p50 va p52 ikkalasi o‘chirilgan sichqonlarda osteoklast hosil bo‘lmaydi (og‘ir osteopetroz).

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 8 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nima uchun p50/p52 o‘chirilsa osteoklast hosil bo‘lmaydi? 2) Qaysi yo‘l yallig‘lanish sitokinlari bilan bog‘liq? Doskada: ikki ustunli sxema chizing: retseptor → kinaza → dimer → yadro. Tipik xato: p100 ni p52 ga aylanishini kanonik yo‘lga bog‘lash.

slides.title: TRAF oilasi: TRAF6 va TRAF3

bullets.text: RANK kinaza faolligiga ega emas; u TRAF oqsillarini jalb qilib, MAPK, NF-κB va AP-1 yo‘llarini yoqadi.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

bullets.text: RANK jalb qiladigan TRAFlardan faqat TRAF6 nokaut sichqonlari osteopetrotik: TRAF6 zarur.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

bullets.text: TRAF3 osteoklastogenezni cheklaydi; RANKL uni parchalaganda p52 ko‘payib, osteoklast hosil bo‘ladi.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 8 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nima uchun TRAF3 ni ‘tormoz’, TRAF6 ni ‘gaz pedali’ deb atash mumkin? 2) TRAF3 parchalanishini to‘xtatish nimaga olib keladi? Doskada: osteoklastning suyakka qaragan yuzasini chizing: sealing zone, ruffled border, lakuna. Tipik xato: ruffled border bilan sealing zone ni aralashtirish. Diqqat: sealing zone ≠ ruffled border; birinchisi yopuvchi halqa, ikkinchisi sekretsiya qiladigan burmali membrana. Eslab qoling: oldin yopishadi, keyin halqa yopadi, so‘ng burmali membrana kislota va ferment chiqaradi.

slides.title: Tezkor savol: fuziya va qutblanish

bullets.text: 1-savol: DC-STAMP (dendritik hujayraga xos transmembran oqsil) vazifasi nima? Javob: u preosteoklastlarning o‘zaro qo‘shilishi, ya’ni fuziyasi uchun zarur.

source.author: Shunsuke Uehara va boshq.
source.title: Beyond resorption: targeting osteoclast fusion and polarization to restore balanced bone remodeling, Frontiers in Pharmacology

bullets.text: 2-savol: Src o‘chirilsa nima bo‘ladi? Javob: burmali chegara va zichlovchi zona hosil bo‘lmaydi, og‘ir osteopetroz rivojlanadi.

source.author: Shunsuke Uehara va boshq.
source.title: Beyond resorption: targeting osteoclast fusion and polarization to restore balanced bone remodeling, Frontiers in Pharmacology

bullets.text: 3-savol: LRRK1 (leysinga boy takroriy kinaza 1) roli? Javob: c-Src va Rho-oilasi GTPazalarini birlashtiradi; usiz osteoklast farqlanadi, lekin zichlovchi zona hosil qilmaydi.

source.author: Shunsuke Uehara va boshq.
source.title: Beyond resorption: targeting osteoclast fusion and polarization to restore balanced bone remodeling, Frontiers in Pharmacology

bullets.text: Diqqat: fuziya ≠ qutblanish. Fuziya — ko‘p yadroli hujayra hosil bo‘lishi; qutblanish — yetuk hujayrada sitoskelet qayta tashkillanishi va burmali chegara paydo bo‘lishi.

source.author: Shunsuke Uehara va boshq.
source.title: Beyond resorption: targeting osteoclast fusion and polarization to restore balanced bone remodeling, Frontiers in Pharmacology

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daq. Muhokama: 1) Fuziya buzilsa ham osteoklast bo‘ladimi? 2) Qutblanish buzilsa-chi? Doskaga chizing: preosteoklast → fuziya → ko‘p yadroli hujayra → qutblanish → burmali chegara. Tipik xato: fuziya va qutblanishni bitta jarayon deb o‘ylash.

slides.title: Mavjud antirezorbtiv dorilar

bullets.text: Azotsiz bisfosfonatlar (etidronat) ATP analogiga aylanib, osteoklast apoptoziga olib keladi.

source.author: Shunsuke Uehara va boshq.
source.title: Beyond resorption: targeting osteoclast fusion and polarization to restore balanced bone remodeling, Frontiers in Pharmacology

bullets.text: Azotli turlari (alendronat) mevalonat yo‘lidagi farnezil pirofosfat sintazani bosadi.

source.author: Shunsuke Uehara va boshq.
source.title: Beyond resorption: targeting osteoclast fusion and polarization to restore balanced bone remodeling, Frontiers in Pharmacology

bullets.text: Denosumabni birdan to‘xtatish suyak almashinuvi rebound sakrashi va ko‘p umurtqa sinishi xavfini beradi.

source.author: Shunsuke Uehara va boshq.
source.title: Beyond resorption: targeting osteoclast fusion and polarization to restore balanced bone remodeling, Frontiers in Pharmacology

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 8 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega denosumabni to‘satdan to‘xtatish xavfli? 2) Uzoq muddatli bisfosfonat nega atipik sinishga olib kelishi mumkin? Doskaga: ikki dori uchun ta’sir zanjirini chizing. Tipik xato: bisfosfonat ham RANKL ni bloklaydi deb o‘ylash.

slides.title: Yangi nishonlar va dorilar

bullets.text: PKN3 (protein kinaza N3) nishoni: SB202190 aktin halqa va rezorbsiyani kamaytirdi, suyak yo‘qolishini oldi.

source.author: Shunsuke Uehara va boshq.
source.title: Beyond resorption: targeting osteoclast fusion and polarization to restore balanced bone remodeling, Frontiers in Pharmacology

bullets.text: Bu vositalar suyak hosil bo‘lishiga ta’sir qilmasdan rezorbsiyani bosish maqsadida o‘rganilmoqda.

source.author: Shunsuke Uehara va boshq.
source.title: Beyond resorption: targeting osteoclast fusion and polarization to restore balanced bone remodeling, Frontiers in Pharmacology

bullets.text: Hammasi tajriba bosqichida; odamda samaradorlik va xavfsizlik hali isbotlanmagan.

source.author: Shunsuke Uehara va boshq.
source.title: Beyond resorption: targeting osteoclast fusion and polarization to restore balanced bone remodeling, Frontiers in Pharmacology

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 7 daq. Muhokama: 1) Fuziyani yoki qutblanishni to‘sish qaysi jihatdan afzal? 2) Nega klinikadan oldin odamda xavfsizlikni tekshirish shart? Doskaga: nishon → modda → bosqich jadvalini ko‘chiring. Tipik xato: tajriba natijalarini tasdiqlangan davo deb qabul qilish.

slides.title: Kupling omillar va PDGF-BB xavfi

bullets.text: Osteoklast faqat suyakni yemirmaydi: u S1P, Wnt10b, BMP6 va CTHRC1 kabi kupling omillarni ajratib, osteoblastlarni jalb qiladi va mineralizatsiyani qo‘llab-quvvatlaydi.

source.author: Shunsuke Uehara va boshq.
source.title: Beyond resorption: targeting osteoclast fusion and polarization to restore balanced bone remodeling, Frontiers in Pharmacology

bullets.text: Bir yadroli pre-osteoklastlar PDGF-BB (trombotsitdan olingan o‘sish omili-BB) ajratadi; u H turdagi qon tomirlar va suyak hosil bo‘lishini rag‘batlantiradi.

source.author: Shunsuke Uehara va boshq.
source.title: Beyond resorption: targeting osteoclast fusion and polarization to restore balanced bone remodeling, Frontiers in Pharmacology

bullets.text: Diqqat: PDGF-BB ortiqcha bo‘lsa, tomir kalsifikatsiyasi, ateroskleroz yoki miya tomirlari buzilishi mumkin; osteoartrozda og‘riq ham kuchayadi.

source.author: Shunsuke Uehara va boshq.
source.title: Beyond resorption: targeting osteoclast fusion and polarization to restore balanced bone remodeling, Frontiers in Pharmacology

bullets.text: Shu sabab pre-osteoklastlarni ko‘paytirish strategiyasi ayrim bemorlarda qarshi ko‘rsatma bo‘lishi mumkin; muqobil — qo‘shilishni emas, osteoklast qutblanishini bostirish.

source.author: Shunsuke Uehara va boshq.
source.title: Beyond resorption: targeting osteoclast fusion and polarization to restore balanced bone remodeling, Frontiers in Pharmacology

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nima uchun osteoklastni butunlay o‘chirish yaxshi emas? 2) PDGF-BB foydasi va xavfi qayerda? Doskada: osteoklast markazda, atrofida S1P, Wnt10b, BMP6, CTHRC1 o‘qlari osteoblastga, PDGF-BB o‘qi tomirga. Tipik xato: PDGF-BB ni faqat foydali omil deb o‘ylash; manbada ortiqcha miqdori xavfli deyiladi.

slides.title: Voqea tahlili: denosumabni to‘xtatish

bullets.text: Denosumab (RANKLga qarshi antitana) to‘satdan to‘xtatilsa, suyak aylanishi markerlari (kollagen o‘zaro bog‘i CTX, prokollagen propeptidi P1NP) keskin oshadi — “rebound”.

source.author: Shunsuke Uehara va boshq.
source.title: Beyond resorption: targeting osteoclast fusion and polarization to restore balanced bone remodeling, Frontiers in Pharmacology

bullets.text: To‘xtatgandan 6 oy o‘tgach bemorlar zardobida RANKL oshgan, so‘ng osteoklast faolligi markeri TRAcP5b (tartratga chidamli kislotali fosfataza 5b) ko‘tarilgan.

source.author: Yin L va boshq.
source.title: Critical signaling pathways in osteoclast differentiation and bone resorption: mechanisms and therapeutic implications for periprosthetic osteolysis, Frontiers in Cell and Developmental Biology

bullets.text: Suyak mineral zichligi (BMD) tez yo‘qoladi; boshqa antirezorbtivga ketma-ket o‘tilmasa, ko‘p umurtqa sinishi xavfi oshadi.

source.author: Shunsuke Uehara va boshq.
source.title: Beyond resorption: targeting osteoclast fusion and polarization to restore balanced bone remodeling, Frontiers in Pharmacology

bullets.text: Savol: bunday bemorda to‘xtatishdan keyin qanday chiqish strategiyasini tanlaysiz va nima uchun?

source.author: Shunsuke Uehara va boshq.
source.title: Beyond resorption: targeting osteoclast fusion and polarization to restore balanced bone remodeling, Frontiers in Pharmacology

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 7 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega RANKL to‘xtatishdan keyin to‘planib, osteoklastlarni oshiradi? 2) Chiqish strategiyasi nimani oldini oladi? Doskada: vaqt o‘qi — davolash, to‘xtatish, 6 oy, RANKL va TRAcP5b o‘sishi, BMD tushishi. Tipik xato: denosumabni bisfosfonat kabi suyakda qoladi deb o‘ylash; u suyakka joylashmaydi, ta’siri qaytuvchan.

slides.title: Xulosa: rezorbsiya shakllari va yo‘nalishlar

bullets.text: Fiziologik rezorbsiya: remodellanishda osteoklastlar eskirgan yoki shikastlangan suyak sohalarini yemiradi, so‘ng osteoblastlar o‘rniga yangisini qo‘yadi.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

bullets.text: Yallig‘lanishli rezorbsiya (periprostetik osteoliz, artrit): TNF-α va IL-1β RANKLni oshirib, OPGni kamaytiradi; estrogen yetishmasligi ham shunday ta’sir qiladi.

source.author: Yin L va boshq.
source.title: Critical signaling pathways in osteoclast differentiation and bone resorption: mechanisms and therapeutic implications for periprosthetic osteolysis, Frontiers in Cell and Developmental Biology

bullets.text: Infeksiya, endokrin buzilish va suyakka tarqalgan o‘smalar rezorbsiyani kuchaytirib, suyak hosil bo‘lishini susaytiradi; natijada osteoporoz yoki litik o‘choqlar paydo bo‘ladi.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

bullets.text: Kelajak: bisfosfonat/denosumab bilan soni kamaytirish, qo‘shilishni va qutblanishni tanlab to‘sish — hosil bo‘lishni saqlagan holda rezorbsiyani jilovlash.

source.author: Shunsuke Uehara va boshq.
source.title: Beyond resorption: targeting osteoclast fusion and polarization to restore balanced bone remodeling, Frontiers in Pharmacology

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) Qaysi shaklda RANKL/OPG muvozanati buziladi? 2) Nega bitta nishonli davo yetarli emas? Doskada: to‘rt shakl (fiziologik, yallig‘lanishli, gormonal, o‘smaga bog‘liq) va ularni bog‘lovchi yo‘llar RANKL/RANK/OPG, NF-κB, MAPK/ERK. Tipik xato: barcha rezorbsiyani patologik deb hisoblash; remodellanishda u normal jarayon.

mcq.question: Suyak kesmasida reversiya chiziqlari tartibsiz bo‘lib, to‘qima mozaika tusini olgan. Bu naqsh klassik tarzda qaysi holatda uchraydi?
options: Osteopetrozda, osteoklastlar umuman bo‘lmaganda
Suyakning Paget kasalligida, rezorbsiya tezlashganda
Sog‘lom kattalar suyagida, odatdagi qayta qurilishda
Revmatoid artritda, bo‘g‘im yallig‘lanishi tufayli
mcq.explanation: Normal qayta qurilishda osteoklastlar silliq tubli tarnov hosil qiladi. Rezorbsiya tezlashgan patologik jarayonlarda tartibsiz reversiya chiziqlari paydo bo‘lib, suyakka mozaika tusini beradi. Bu eng klassik tarzda Paget kasalligida ko‘rinadi.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

mcq.question: Tadqiqotchi osteoklastning proton nasoslari va xlor kanallarini bloklab qo‘ydi. Rezorbsiyaning qaysi bosqichi birinchi bo‘lib buziladi?
options: Kollagen matriksning metalloproteazalar bilan parchalanishi
Rezorbsiya chuqurchasiga osteoblastlarning jalb etilishi
Osteoklastning apoptoz orqali o‘lishi bosqichi
Suyak mineralining kislota bilan eritilishi bosqichi
mcq.explanation: Osteoklast avval H+ ionlari va Cl− ionlari orqali xlorid kislota hosil qilib suyak mineralini eritadi, shundan keyingina metalloproteazalar kollagen matriksni parchalaydi. Demineralizatsiyada ishtirok etuvchi genlardagi mutatsiyalar odamdagi osteopetroz holatlarining ko‘pchiligiga sabab bo‘ladi.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

mcq.question: Osteoklastlar qaysi hujayralarning o‘zaro qo‘shilishidan hosil bo‘ladi?
options: Suyak iligidagi gemopoetik miyeloid prekursorlar
Mezenximadan chiqqan osteoblast prekursorlari
Suyak ichiga ko‘milgan yetuk osteotsitlar
Xaftaga xos gipertrofik xondrotsitlar
mcq.explanation: Osteoklastlar ko‘p yadroli hujayralar bo‘lib, odatda suyak yuzasi yaqinidagi suyak iligida gemopoetik miyeloid prekursorlarning qo‘shilishidan hosil bo‘ladi. Osteoblastlar esa mezenximadan kelib chiqadi.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

mcq.question: Protez atrofidagi bo‘shashgan implantli bemor to‘qimasida RANKL yuqori, OPG past topildi. Bundan qanday natija kutiladi?
options: Osteoklast hosil bo‘lishi pasayib, suyak zichlashadi
Osteoklast faolligi o‘zgarmay, muvozanat saqlanadi
Osteoklast faolligi oshib, osteoliz tezlashadi
Osteoblast prekursorlari rezorbsiyani to‘xtatadi
mcq.explanation: OPG RANKLni bog‘lab, uning RANK bilan o‘zaro ta’sirini to‘sadigan ‘‘o‘lja’’ retseptor. RANKL ko‘payib OPG kamayganda osteoklastlar ortiqcha faollashadi, rezorbsiya va osteoliz tezlashadi. Implant bo‘shashgan bemorlarning to‘qimasida aynan shu holat kuzatilgan.

source.author: Yin L va boshq.
source.title: Critical signaling pathways in osteoclast differentiation and bone resorption: mechanisms and therapeutic implications for periprosthetic osteolysis, Frontiers in Cell and Developmental Biology

mcq.question: Kortikal suyakda yumaloq tunnel hosil bo‘lib, uni yangi suyak deyarli to‘ldirgan; markazda mayda arteriya va vena qolgan. Bu qanday tuzilma?
options: Rezorbsiya chuqurchasini yopuvchi yupqa kanopi pardasi
Yangi suyak bilan to‘lgan tunnel, ya’ni osteon tuzilmasi
Trabekula yuzasidagi reversiya chizig‘li tarnov tuzilmasi
Osteoklast pastki yuzasidagi gofrirlangan chekka tuzilmasi
mcq.explanation: Osteoklastlar zich kortikal suyakni yumaloq tunnellar hosil qilib yemiradi. Bu tunnellar yangi suyak bilan deyarli to‘lib osteonlarni hosil qiladi; osteonda kichik markaziy oziqlantiruvchi arteriya va vena bo‘ladi. G‘ovak suyakda esa tarnov shaklidagi qayta qurilish birliklari hosil bo‘ladi.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

mcq.question: Voyaga yetgan sichqonda RANKL geni faqat osteotsitlarda o‘chirildi. Qanday natija kutiladi?
options: Osteoklastlar ko‘payib, osteoporoz rivojlanadi
Osteoklastlar hosil bo‘lmay, osteopetroz rivojlanadi
Osteoblastlar yo‘qolib, suyak hosil bo‘lmaydi
Embrional skelet rivojlanishi butunlay to‘xtaydi
mcq.explanation: Osteotsitlar RANKL ning muhim manbai hisoblanadi. Osteotsitda RANKL o‘chirilganda osteoklast hosil bo‘lishi buziladi va og‘ir osteopetroz rivojlanadi. Osteotsit RANKL‘i embrional davrdagi osteoklastlar uchun shart emas, lekin o‘smir va voyaga yetgan skeletdagi normal remodeling uchun zarur.

source.author: Yin L va boshq.
source.title: Critical signaling pathways in osteoclast differentiation and bone resorption: mechanisms and therapeutic implications for periprosthetic osteolysis, Frontiers in Cell and Developmental Biology

mcq.question: Endoprotezdan keyin implanti bo‘shashgan bemorning periprotez to‘qimasida RANKL/OPG nisbati qanday o‘zgargan bo‘ladi?
options: RANKL ham, OPG ham bir xil darajada kamaygan bo‘ladi
RANKL kamaygan, OPG esa sezilarli darajada oshgan bo‘ladi
RANKL darajasi oshgan, OPG darajasi esa kamaygan bo‘ladi
RANKL ham, OPG ham deyarli o‘zgarmagan bo‘ladi
mcq.explanation: Yeyilish zarralari TNF-α va IL-1β ni ko‘paytiradi. Bu sitokinlar RANKL ni oshiradi va OPG ni kamaytiradi. Implanti bo‘shashgan bemorlarning periprotez to‘qimalarida RANKL yuqori, OPG past topilgan. Bu osteolizning tezlashishi bilan bog‘liq.

source.author: Yin L va boshq.
source.title: Critical signaling pathways in osteoclast differentiation and bone resorption: mechanisms and therapeutic implications for periprosthetic osteolysis, Frontiers in Cell and Developmental Biology

mcq.question: LGR4 retseptori osteoklast hosil bo‘lishini qaysi mexanizm orqali cheklaydi?
options: RANKL ni parchalab, uning miqdorini kamaytirish orqali
M-CSF retseptorini bloklab, prekursorlarni kamaytirish orqali
TRAF6 ni faollashtirib, NF-κB signalini kuchaytirish orqali
RANKL uchun RANK bilan raqobatlashib, NFATc1 ni bostirish orqali
mcq.explanation: LGR4 RANKL ning qo‘shimcha retseptori bo‘lib, RANK bilan raqobatlashadi. U Gαq va GSK3-β signalini faollashtiradi. Bu signal osteoklast shakllanishi uchun zarur transkripsiya omili NFATc1 ning ifodasini va faolligini bostiradi.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

mcq.question: RANKL‘siz sichqonning katta suyagi kesmasi TRAP bilan bo‘yaldi. Qanday ko‘rinish kuzatiladi?
options: TRAP-musbat osteoklastlar yo‘q, ilik bo‘shlig‘i qayta shakllanmagan suyak bilan to‘lgan
TRAP-musbat osteoklastlar ko‘p, ilik bo‘shlig‘i kengaygan va suyak yupqalashgan
TRAP-musbat osteoklastlar normal miqdorda, ilik bo‘shlig‘i ham odatdagidek ochiq
TRAP-musbat osteoklastlar yo‘q, ilik bo‘shlig‘i esa mutlaqo bo‘sh qolgan
mcq.explanation: RANKL yoki RANK yetishmasa, osteoklastlar hosil bo‘lmaydi va osteopetroz rivojlanadi. Suyak qayta shakllanmaydi va ilik bo‘shlig‘i zich suyak bilan to‘ladi. RANK−/− sichqon suyagida TRAP-musbat hujayralar ko‘rinmaydi.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

mcq.question: RANKL bilan qo‘zg‘atilgan osteoklast prekursorlariga xloroxin qo‘shildi. Qanday natija kuzatiladi?
options: TRAF3 parchalanishi kuchayib, NIK to‘planadi va osteoklastlar ko‘payadi
TRAF3 parchalanishi kuchayib, p100 to‘liq p52 ga aylanadi va osteoklastlar ko‘payadi
TRAF3 parchalanmay saqlanadi, NIK parchalanadi va osteoklast hosil bo‘lishi kamayadi
TRAF3 parchalanmay saqlanadi, NIK to‘planadi va osteoklast hosil bo‘lishi kuchayadi
mcq.explanation: RANKL TRAF3 ning lizosoma yo‘li bilan parchalanishiga olib keladi. Shunda NIK to‘planadi va p100 p52 ga aylanadi. Xloroxin lizosomal parchalanishni to‘sadi va TRAF3 saqlanib qoladi. TRAF3 NIK ning proteasomal parchalanishini ta’minlaydi, natijada osteoklast hosil bo‘lishi kamayadi.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

mcq.question: Revizion jarrohlikda periprotez to‘qimasida turli eskirish zarrachalari topildi. Qaysi zarracha eng kuchli yallig‘lantiruvchi ta’sir ko‘rsatishi ehtimol?
options: Yirik sharsimon polietilen zarrasi
Submikron o‘lchamli cho‘zinchoq zarra
Yirik silliq sharsimon seramika zarrasi
Kattaroq o‘lchamli sharsimon metall zarra
mcq.explanation: Submikron o‘lchamli va cho‘zinchoq zarralar kattaroq yoki sharsimon zarralarga nisbatan kuchliroq yallig‘lantiruvchi ta’sir ko‘rsatadi. Zarraning o‘lchami, shakli va kimyoviy tarkibi uning bioreaktivligini belgilaydi.

source.author: Yin L va boshq.
source.title: Critical signaling pathways in osteoclast differentiation and bone resorption: mechanisms and therapeutic implications for periprosthetic osteolysis, Frontiers in Cell and Developmental Biology

mcq.question: TRAF3 osteoklast prekursorlarida o‘chirilgan sichqonlarda tuxumdonlar olib tashlangach, xloroxin berildi. Xloroxin ta’siri qanday bo‘ldi?
options: Suyak yo‘qotilishi to‘liq oldi olindi
Osteoklastlar soni normadan ham kamaydi
Osteoblastlar soni keskin ko‘paydi
Suyak yo‘qotilishi oldi olinmadi
mcq.explanation: Xloroxin TRAF3 parchalanishini to‘xtatish orqali ishlaydi. TRAF3 butunlay o‘chirilgan sichqonlarda xloroxinning nishoni yo‘q, shuning uchun u ovariektomiyadan keyingi suyak yo‘qotilishini to‘xtata olmadi.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

mcq.question: Bemor uzoq muddat glyukokortikoid (deksametazon) qabul qilmoqda. Osteoblastlarda qaysi o‘zgarish suyak rezorbsiyasini kuchaytiradi?
options: OPG kamayadi, RANKL ortadi
OPG ortadi, RANKL kamayadi
OPG ham, RANKL ham bir xil kamayadi
OPG ham, RANKL ham o‘zgarishsiz qoladi
mcq.explanation: Glyukokortikoidlar osteoblastlarda OPG ifodasini pasaytiradi va RANKL ifodasini oshiradi. Natijada osteoklastlar faollashadi, rezorbsiya kuchayadi va osteoporoz rivojlanadi.

source.author: Yin L va boshq.
source.title: Critical signaling pathways in osteoclast differentiation and bone resorption: mechanisms and therapeutic implications for periprosthetic osteolysis, Frontiers in Cell and Developmental Biology

mcq.question: Osteoklast prekursorlarida TRAF3 miqdoriga RANKL va TNF qanday ta’sir qiladi?
options: Ikkalasi ham TRAF3 ni parchalaydi
RANKL TRAF3 ni oshiradi, TNF kamaytiradi
RANKL TRAF3 ni parchalaydi, TNF oshiradi
Ikkalasi ham TRAF3 ni oshiradi
mcq.explanation: RANKL TRAF3 degradatsiyasini chaqirib, p100 ning p52 ga o‘tishini va osteoklast hosil bo‘lishini kuchaytiradi. TNF esa TRAF3 va p100 miqdorini oshiradi, bu esa osteoklast hosil bo‘lishini cheklaydi.

source.author: Boyce BF va boshq.
source.title: Bone Remodeling and the Role of TRAF3 in Osteoclastic Bone Resorption, Frontiers in Immunology

mcq.question: Artroplastikadan keyin og‘riq tufayli bemor oyog‘iga yuklamani keskin kamaytirdi. Osteositlarda qaysi o‘zgarish periprostetik osteolizni tezlashtiradi?
options: RANKL ifodasining ortishi
OPG ifodasining ortishi
Osteositlar apoptozining kamayishi
Makrofaglarning M2 turga o‘tishi
mcq.explanation: Mexanik yuklama kamayganda osteositlarda RANKL ifodasi sezilarli ortadi, bu osteoklastlar differensiatsiyasini bevosita faollashtiradi. Shu tariqa protezdan keyingi harakatsizlik osteolizni tezlashtiradi.

mcq.question: Tendon qobig‘ining gigant hujayrali o‘smasi biopsiyasida TRAP-musbat (tartratga chidamli kislotali fosfataza) va TRAP-manfiy ko‘p yadroli hujayralar topildi. Qaysi hujayralar suyakni rezorbsiya qiladi?
options: TRAP-manfiy, xolesterin yoriqlari yonidagi yot jism gigant hujayralari
TRAP-musbat hujayralar, ya’ni o‘smadagi haqiqiy osteoklastlar
Ikkala turdagi ko‘p yadroli hujayralar suyakni bir xil darajada rezorbsiya qiladi
O‘sma stromasidagi bir yadroli mononuklear hujayralar suyakni rezorbsiya qiladi
mcq.explanation: Skeletdan tashqari lezyonlarda TRAP-musbat osteoklastlar ham, TRAP-manfiy ko‘p yadroli hujayralar ham bo‘lishi mumkin. TRAP-manfiy polikarionlar suyakni rezorbsiya qilmaydi. Ular xolesterin va yot agentlarni parchalaydi.

mcq.question: Sichqonda DC-STAMP (dendritik hujayraga xos transmembran oqsil) geni o‘chirildi. Osteoklast markerlari ifodasi normal. Tadqiqotchilar qanday natijani kutadi?
options: Osteoklast markerlari yo‘qoladi va osteoklastlar umuman hosil bo‘lmaydi
Osteoklastlar o‘ta yirik bo‘lib, suyak rezorbsiyasi keskin kuchayadi
Faqat qutblanish buziladi, ko‘p yadroli osteoklastlar odatdagidek hosil bo‘ladi
Ko‘p yadroli hujayralar hosil bo‘lmaydi, rezorbsiya susayib osteopetroz rivojlanadi
mcq.explanation: DC-STAMP osteoklast fuziyasi uchun zarur. Gomozigotalarda markerlar normal bo‘lsa ham ko‘p yadroli hujayra hosil bo‘lishi to‘liq to‘xtaydi. Natijada rezorbsiya pasayadi va osteopetroz paydo bo‘ladi.

mcq.question: Sichqonda LRRK1 (leysinga boy takroriy kinaza 1) geni o‘chirilgan. Osteoklastlar M-CSF va RANKL ta’sirida normal differensiatsiyalanadi. Qaysi funksiya buziladi?
options: Muhrlovchi zona va burmali chegara hosil bo‘lishi, F-aktin tartibi buziladi
Bir yadroli preosteoklastlarning o‘zaro qo‘shilishi (fuziya) to‘liq to‘xtaydi
RANK retseptorining prekursor hujayra yuzasida ifodalanishi butunlay yo‘qoladi
Prekursorlarning M-CSF ta’sirida osteoklastga differensiatsiyalanishi to‘xtaydi
mcq.explanation: LRRK1 yetishmasa osteoklastlar normal differensiatsiyalanadi. Lekin ular muhrlovchi zona va burmali chegara hosil qila olmaydi, F-aktin tartibsiz bo‘ladi va kislota hamda proteazalar sekretsiyasi buziladi. Natijada og‘ir osteopetroz rivojlanadi.

mcq.question: Osteoporozli bemor denosumabni birdaniga to‘xtatdi va boshqa antirezorbtiv dori boshlanmadi. Qaysi xavf ko‘proq kutiladi?
options: Osteoklastlar apoptozi kuchayadi va suyak zichligi uzoq muddat saqlanib qoladi
Suyak almashinuvi haddan tashqari bostirilgani uchun atipik son suyagi sinishi ortadi
Suyak almashinuv belgilari (CTX, P1NP) keskin oshadi va ko‘p umurtqa sinishi xavfi ortadi
Suyak yangilanishi to‘liq to‘xtaydi va jag‘ osteonekrozi xavfi butunlay yo‘qoladi
mcq.explanation: Denosumab RANKL ni neytrallaydi, ta’siri qaytar. Uni birdaniga to‘xtatish suyak almashinuv belgilari (CTX, P1NP) keskin oshishiga, mineral zichlikning tez yo‘qolishiga va ko‘p umurtqa sinishi xavfiga olib kelishi mumkin. Shuning uchun antirezorbtiv ketma-ketlik (“exit strategy”) kerak. Atipik son sinishi uzoq muddatli bisfosfonat bilan bog‘liq.

mcq.question: Fuziyani ingibitsiyalab PDGF-BB ishlab chiqaruvchi preosteoklastlar sonini oshirish strategiyasida qaysi xavf ko‘rsatilgan?
options: Gipokalsemiyaning keskin rivojlanishi va qalqonsimon bez funksiyasining buzilishi
PDGF-BB ortiqcha bo‘lsa qon tomir kalsifikatsiyasi, ateroskleroz va miya qon tomirlari buzilishi mumkin
Jag‘ osteonekrozi xavfining onkologik dozalardagi darajaga yetishi
H tip qon tomirlar kamayishi va suyak hosil bo‘lishining to‘xtashi
mcq.explanation: PDGF-BB haddan tashqari ko‘p ishlab chiqarilsa tomir devori hujayralarining osteogen differensiatsiyasi mumkin. Bu ateroskleroz va miya qon tomirlari kalsifikatsiyasiga olib keladi. Shuning uchun PDGF-BB darajasini nazorat qilish zarur. Ba’zi bemorlarda bu strategiya kontrendikatsiya bo‘lishi mumkin.
